Dot coefficient values, number of nonzero summands, and the constructor used to build a dot are not part of its geometric shape. Preserve the ordered oriented wiring, marked vertices, genuine arithmetic expression scopes, trivalent orientations, and fixed boundary groups and centralizer cosets. Separate arbitrary group-algebra intertwiners from this termwise-eligible dot language; do not silently identify all bimodule maps with eligible dot labels. Read the complete original paper and its rendered diagrams, and use the project shared language rather than inventing a private shape grammar in one theorem type.
